name: komdosh-dev-spring-avro
description: Avro schema authoring + autogenerated event DTOs for Kotlin/Spring services. Adds the avro-schema-author agent, /avro-new-event, /avro-evolve, /avro-audit, the discover-avro-toolchain + verify-schema-compat skills, and three rules (schemas, codegen, registry). Defaults to davidmc24/gradle-avro-plugin and Confluent Schema Registry; detects Apicurio and avro4k. Complements komdosh-dev-spring-events (which consumes the generated DTOs). Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
